npcs.name: Coach Arjun
lines: Nathan! Back for another session? // Visitors keep asking me how you changed so much.
I tell them the same thing every time: it wasn't one big moment.
topics: How did he start? :: Write the real story here: when you walked in the first time, what you could and couldn't do. // Keep it short and honest.
What changed? :: Your numbers and habits: training days per week, food, sleep. // What the hardest month was. [memory:coach-advice]
Can I try a lift? :: Step up to the rack. Three clean reps, the zone gets smaller every time. Like real progress.

npcs.name: Classmate
lines: Nathan! You came back to see the old campus? // It still looks the same under all this snow.
topics: What was he like here? :: Write how a classmate would describe you: the subjects you were good at, the study group, the late nights. // One honest, specific detail.
What was it like studying here? :: The language, the lectures, the cold, the people. // Something that surprised you. [memory:first-snow]
What did he take away from here? :: What studying abroad taught you: independence, a new language, a different way of learning. // One thing you still carry with you.

npcs.name: Batchmate
lines: Hey Nathan! Rain's coming again, good thing the banyan is right here. // People keep asking what you were like when you joined.
topics: What was it like when he joined? :: Describe arriving mid-way through your studies: the new city, the new syllabus, how quickly you found your people. // One specific memory.
What did you build together? :: Your college projects, clubs and hackathons. Mention one result you're proud of. [memory:first-hackathon]
What's he like as a teammate? :: How classmates would describe working with you: the role you usually take, how you handle deadlines. // Keep it honest and specific.

npcs.name: Town Guide
lines: Welcome to NATHAN.EXE! This whole town is Nathan's story. // Every ◆ opens a chapter, every ✦ is a memory.
topics: Where should I start? :: Start at the Iron Yard next to the plaza, then follow the chapters in your save file, bottom left. // The Memory Line train gets you between campuses fast.
I'm short on time. :: No problem: the Resume, Projects and Contact buttons at the top work anytime. // Or press Skip game for the classic portfolio.
What's at the lighthouse? :: The ending. Light the lamp when you're ready. // You can keep exploring afterwards.
